The new Apple iPhone Duo is here - and its time for an iPhone Duo Durability Test. Will the new Folding iPhone Duo survive the stress of every day life? Dust, burns, bends, and ripping off its inner nano-texture screen?! Protect your phone TODAY with dbrands grip case: Protection is *always* a good thing.
The iPhone Duo is very similar to other folding phones on the market. I mean... its totally the first folding phone ever made. For sure. There is no way Samsung has already been doing it for 7 years. You would think that the new iPhone Duo would be slightly stronger... but here we are.
